I am a **PhD candidate in Economics** at the [**University of Geneva**](https://www.unige.ch/gsem/en/research/institutes/iee/){target="_blank"}, Switzerland.

My research interests lie at the intersection of **environmental**, **urban**, and **development** economics. In pursuit of generating causally identified and policy-relevant evidence, I employ a variety of data sources, including large **surveys**, **(satellite) remote sensing**, and other **spatial/GIS** data. 

In addition, I enjoy working with **R** and have a strong interest in reproducible research and project management methodologies, which support efficiency and collaboration in research.
